hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs are visible in this mid-block residential section.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway area.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: Encroaching stairs and fences from the adjacent row houses reduce the effective width of the sidewalk, creating potential bottlenecks.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalks on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians lack a dedicated, safe space to walk, separated from vehicle traffic, forcing them into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the entire block edge

hazards.name: Degraded Road Edge
hazards.description: The transition between the road and the grass is unpaved and uneven, creating trip hazards and poor drainage.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the road edge

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian separation
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or curbs, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the path of vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground along the edges of the roadway

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows signs of cracking and wear, which can create tripping hazards for pedestrians sharing the space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: The area adjacent to the curb is unpaved or heavily cracked, creating uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards for those entering or exiting vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway and parking area

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: Private stairs and low retaining walls narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street creates significant blind spots, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians, especially children, attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk shows visible cracking and minor displacement which can be a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground walkway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra markings for the crosswalk are significantly faded, reducing visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection crossing point

hazards.name: Absence of street lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which may create safety and security risks for pedestrians at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible streetscape

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement at the edge of the street to ensure a smooth transition and proper drainage.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
